name: Ohio HEAP heating assistance
description: Help with winter heating bills for households with lower income. You can apply from July 1, 2026 to May 31, 2027. It can take up to twelve weeks.
eligibility: Household income at or below 175% of poverty.

steps: Apply online at energyhelp.ohio.gov. Or set up a time with Miami Valley Community Action Partnership.
documents: List of household members and proof of income for each adult
Most recent gas and electric bills
Birth dates and Social Security numbers for household members
Proof of disability, if it applies
